notes.title: July 12, 2025 Changelog - Alpha 1522
June 15, 2025 Changelog - Alpha 1459
notes.content:
Added a progress bar for looting/disassembling actions.

Added a right-click item moving function, making item storage/retrieval more convenient.

Adjusted furniture placement criteria in hideouts, now allowing larger placement areas.

Enhanced visibility range and brightness for the night-time world map.

Modified save-file screenshot logic, now eliminating annoying screenshot notifications.

Improved the visual design of the world map interface.



Fixed an issue where furniture couldn't be placed in certain hideout areas.

Fixed a bug causing equipment interface freezes in specific situations.

Fixed some issues with save-file logic.

Fixed a world map display glitch where player icons occasionally appeared misaligned.

Fixed various localization issues.

notes.title: June 7, 2025 Changelog - Alpha 1446
notes.content:
Added several tool packs. Tools can now be carried in dedicated tool packs.

Implemented "Return to Hideout" feature: instantly teleport back from anywhere (consumes Energy and Hydration).

Completed descriptions for all existing items.

Adjusted attributes of some food items.

Added new behavioral sound effects.

Added a new random scene.

Fixed several issues in random scenes.

notes.title: June 2, 2025 Changelog - Alpha 1427
notes.content:
Remade the Hideout scene to fix severe frame rate drops.​​
  We apologize that we had to remake this scene to fully fix the previous bug. This means old save files may become incompatible (items originally placed in the scene might be misplaced or disappear). We will pay closer attention to save file compatibility in the future to reduce the chances of saves becoming completely or partially unusable.
 Optimized ray tracing settings.​​
 Added sound effects during movement.​​
 Fixed minor issues in random scenes.​​
 Fixed some minor localization issues.​​
